note: Adapted from the species-level description (Soldier, fig. 17) and TABLE 14 of Krishna and Araujo's revision of the genus Neocapritermes (Bulletin of the American Museum of Natural History, volume 138), originally in English. Only the soldier caste is treated here. The three values for the submentum length in TABLE 14 (lectotype 2.73, range 2.04—2.73, mean 2.25) are mutually incompatible: the mean is neither at the midpoint of that range nor in a coherent relation to the lower limit, so a printing or OCR error in the original is suspected; here they are retained literally, without smoothing. The lectotype value for the maximum head height, 1.12, is also slightly below its range 1.20—1.22 and is likewise transcribed as it stands.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, the anterior margin of the head and the base of the mandibles brown; the lateral margins of the submentum and the antennal segments light brown; mandibles shining black; labrum pale yellow; the rest of the body dirty white. The upper surface of the head bears very few longer, fine, pale erect setae; the apex of the submentum has 1 seta near the margin on each side; the end of the labrum has 2 long forward-pointing setae and about 2 shorter ones near the middle; the thoracic nota bear several long, fine, erect setae, more numerous on the pronotum; the legs are sparsely hairy, with fine setae of 2 lengths; the longitudinal ridge of the fore coxa bears a row of irregular, short, stout, dark setae; the cervical sclerites are bare; the abdominal segments have several irregular transverse rows of setae in 2 lengths, the longer ones more numerous on the distal segments. The head is proportionally long (on average 2.1 times as long as wide and 1.4 times as long as the left mandible), with parallel sides; the posterior corners rounded, passing into a broadly semicircular posterior margin; slightly raised at the anterolateral corner below the antennal base; in dorsal view the top is straight, briefly sloping down at the frons and then sloping over a longer distance to the posterior margin, and the ventral surface is broadly concave; the postclypeal region is distorted, its left side drawn out into a small but conspicuous, spine-like, erect process; the fontanelle is small, circular, almost invisible. Antennae 16-segmented, segment 4 the shortest, segments 4—7 increasing, segments 8—11 slightly longer than segment 12, segments 12—15 slightly decreasing, segment 16 elongate-oval and slightly longer than the preceding segment. Labrum elongate, slightly distorted, its sides flaring outwards, the left side broadly and shallowly concave, the right side slightly convex, the apex with two regular lateral lobes and a trace of a broad midlobe. Mandibles slender, proportionally shorter than the head. In ventral view the left mandible is broadly curved near the base and tapers to the parallel-sided apical 1/3, in lateral view the apex increases upwards. The right mandible is straight in dorsal view, its inner margin very broad and shallowly concave, the upper half broadly concave near the base, the apex slightly broadened and narrowed to a point, very slightly arched in lateral view. Submentum long, its distal half slightly and evenly widened, the sides curved and the apical margin convex; the proximal half has almost straight sides, flaring near the base; the posterior margin almost straight. Pronotum fairly broad, its lobes not angular, the anterior margin semicircular, the posterior margin shallowly concave, the sides straight and rounded at the lateral corners. The posterior margin of the mesonotum is straight in the middle and converges to rounded sides. The metanotum is as wide as the pronotum, its posterior margin broadly and shallowly concave, the sides semicircular and projecting. The outer margin of the apical 1/3 of the mid tibia bears 1 small spine. Measurements (4 soldiers; the three columns in the original are lectotype, range and mean, in that order): head capsule lateral length 3.05 mm, 3.01—3.11 mm, 3.04 mm; maximum head width 1.40 mm, 1.40—1.48 mm, 1.43 mm; maximum head height 1.12 mm, 1.20—1.22 mm, 1.17 mm; left mandible length 2.10 mm, 2.09—2.24 mm, 2.13 mm; right mandible length 2.03 mm, 1.99—2.09 mm, 2.02 mm; maximum submentum width 0.42 mm, 0.42—0.47 mm, 0.45 mm; minimum submentum width 0.25 mm, 0.25—0.31 mm, 0.27 mm; submentum length 2.73 mm, 2.04—2.73 mm, 2.25 mm; pronotal midline length 0.56 mm, 0.52—0.56 mm, 0.54 mm; pronotal maximum length 0.56 mm, 0.52—0.56 mm, 0.54 mm; pronotal maximum width 0.95 mm, 0.92—0.97 mm, 0.94 mm; hind tibia length 1.05 mm, 1.05—1.10 mm, 1.07 mm.
